questions.prompt: What command lists all storage pools?
questions.explanation: lxc storage list shows all pools, their driver, and usage.

questions.prompt: Which storage driver is recommended for most LXD setups?
questions.explanation: ZFS supports snapshots, compression, and copy-on-write — making it the recommended default.

questions.prompt: How do you create a custom volume named 'data' in pool 'default'?
options: lxc storage volume create default data
questions.answer: lxc storage volume create default data
questions.explanation: lxc storage volume create <pool> <name> creates a custom volume.

questions.prompt: Select all valid reasons to use custom volumes:
questions.explanation: Custom volumes persist independently, can be shared, and can be backed up separately. They don't affect boot times or create images.

questions.prompt: How do you attach a custom volume 'data' to instance 'web' at '/mnt/data'?
questions.answer: lxc storage volume attach default data web /mnt/data
questions.explanation: lxc storage volume attach <pool> <volume> <instance> <mount-point> attaches a custom volume as a disk device.

questions.prompt: Can you delete a custom volume that is still attached to an instance?
options: No — you must detach it first
Yes — the volume is moved to the recycle bin
questions.answer: No — you must detach it first
questions.explanation: LXD prevents deleting volumes that are in use. Detach the volume from all instances first.
